about: P207: the single source of truth for every mouse / touch gesture and keyboard shortcut of the Agent J web app. Never edit the generated files; add an entry with `agentjarvis/tools/interactions add`, then `render`; `check` runs in the p44 gates.

globalNote.zh: 功能键在输入框聚焦时也有效。系统或输入法占用的组合可能无法传到页面；ChromeOS 的 Alt+Shift+M 会打开文件应用，请从模型菜单恢复默认。
globalNote.en: Function keys also work while a text field is focused. System or input-method shortcuts may intercept them; on ChromeOS Alt+Shift+M opens Files, so restore defaults from the model menu.

capturePending.zh: 截图功能将在本次集成后可用。
capturePending.en: Page capture will be available after this integration.

cards.zh: 卡片（Alt+Shift，按你现有的卡片自动分配）
cards.en: Cards (Alt+Shift, given to the cards you have)

entries.zh: 上一条（更早）
entries.en: Previous page (older)
entries.gesture_zh: 卡片向右滑；横屏点左边的 ‹
entries.gesture_en: Swipe the cards right; in landscape tap ‹ on the left

entries.zh: 下一条（更新）
entries.en: Next page (newer)
entries.gesture_zh: 卡片向左滑；横屏点右边的 ›
entries.gesture_en: Swipe the cards left; in landscape tap › on the right

target.en: Right third of the message card header (page number)

entries.zh: 跳到最新一条
entries.en: Jump to the newest page
entries.gesture_zh: 双击页眉右边 1/3（页码）；页码闪烁时单击也行
entries.gesture_en: Double-tap the right third of the header (page number); a single tap while it flashes

target.en: Left third of the message card header

entries.zh: 跳到最早一条（更早的会从Agent J 主机上取）
entries.en: Jump to the earliest page (older ones are fetched from the computer)
entries.gesture_en: Double-tap the left third of the header

target.zh: 消息卡页眉中间 1/3（未读圆标）
target.en: Middle third of the message card header (unread badge)

entries.zh: 跳到第一条未读（所有遥控器同步已读），再一张张往后翻
entries.en: Jump to the first unread reply (read status syncs across your remotes), then page forward
entries.gesture_zh: 点页眉中间 1/3 的未读圆标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the unread badge in the middle third of the header

target.en: The quoted message inside a message

entries.zh: 跳到这一条引用的那条消息
entries.en: Jump to the message this one quotes
entries.gesture_en: Tap the quote above the message

entries.zh: 展开 / 收起原话（↑ 展开，↓ 收起；没有可展开的时候 ↑ ↓ 在消息里滚一段）
entries.en: Expand / fold the message (↑ expands, ↓ folds; with nothing to toggle ↑ ↓ scroll the page)
entries.gesture_zh: 点右边的 … 按钮；双击原话
entries.gesture_en: Tap the … button on the right; double-tap the message

entries.zh: 往下翻一屏（Shift+空格 往上）
entries.en: Scroll down one screen (Shift+Space up)

entries.zh: 全屏阅读这条回复
entries.en: Read this reply full screen
entries.gesture_zh: 点书本图标；双击回复空白、正文或音频卡
entries.gesture_en: Tap the book icon; double-tap reply text, blank space or an audio card

entries.zh: 朗读这条回复（再按一次停下）
entries.en: Read this reply aloud (press again to stop)

target.zh: 回复卡底部「转发给我自己」

entries.zh: 把这条回复转发给自己（没设置转发时用手机的分享）
entries.en: Forward this reply to yourself (the phone's share sheet when forwarding is not set up)

target.zh: 回复卡底部「转发到邮箱」

entries.zh: 把这一条转发到邮箱（邮件通道打开时才有）
entries.en: Forward this one by e-mail (when the e-mail channel is on)

entries.zh: 复制整条回复
entries.en: Copy the whole reply

entries.zh: 复制整段原话（纯语音的话复制转写文字）
entries.en: Copy the whole message (a voice-only message: its transcript)
entries.gesture_zh: 点原话卡右下角展开 / 收起按钮左边的拷贝图标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the copy icon just left of expand / collapse at the card's bottom right

entries.zh: 回复这一条（引用条出现在输入框上方，焦点留在输入框，Esc 取消）；Alt+Shift+A 在输入框里也能用
entries.en: Reply to this one (the quote shows above the message box, focus stays in it; Esc cancels); Alt+Shift+A also works while typing
entries.allowReserved: Leo 10-15 chose Alt+Shift+A (Answer) as the global reply key; ChromeOS may take it — r and the reply icon still work

keywords.zh: 回答 引用 回复

entries.zh: 选中一段文字就引用它；再选别处是再加一段（最多 5 段，可以来自不同回复，全屏阅读里选也算）
entries.en: Select some words to quote them; each further selection adds one more (up to 5, from any replies, also in the full-screen reader)
entries.nokey: Text selection is the gesture itself; r quotes the whole reply.

target.zh: 回复卡左下角快捷技能键（默认「分享成网页报告」）
target.en: Reply card, bottom left: the hot key (default: share as a web report)

entries.zh: 快捷技能键：默认分享成网页报告（输入框放好 /web-page-report，可补一句，不自动发送；在旧卡上点同时引用这张）；换绑后执行你选的命令或技能，/clear 照旧先确认
entries.en: Hot key: by default share as a web report (puts /web-page-report in the message box, never sends; on an older reply also quotes it); once rebound, runs the command or skill you chose — /clear still asks first
entries.gesture_zh: 点左下角圆形分享图标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the round share icon at the bottom left

target.zh: 回复卡左下角快捷技能键
target.en: Reply card, bottom left: the hot key

entries.zh: 换快捷技能键绑定的命令或技能（可搜索，确认后保存；图标不变）
entries.en: Change which command or skill the hot key runs (search, confirm, saved; the icon stays the same)
entries.gesture_zh: 长按左下角圆形分享图标
entries.gesture_en: Hold the round share icon at the bottom left
entries.nokey: a hold opens a picker sheet; W already taps it

entries.zh: 预览这一页的第一个文件（预览里 ← → 换下一个）
entries.en: Preview the first file on this page (← → in the preview for the others)
entries.gesture_zh: 点文件卡、图片或「全屏查看」；双击非音频文件卡直接查看文件全屏
entries.gesture_en: Tap the file card, picture or Full screen; double-tap a non-audio file card to view that file full screen

entries.zh: 下载这一页的第一个文件
entries.en: Download the first file on this page

entries.zh: 用系统分享发出这一页的第一个文件
entries.en: Share the first file on this page with the system share sheet

entries.zh: 把这一页的第一个文件转发到邮箱
entries.en: Forward the first file on this page by e-mail
entries.gesture_zh: 点文件卡上的信封图标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the envelope icon on the file card

entries.zh: 把这一页的第一个文件转发给自己
entries.en: Forward the first file on this page to yourself
entries.gesture_zh: 点文件卡上的箭头图标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the arrow icon on the file card

entries.zh: 换页面字号（中 → 大 → 中 → 小）
entries.en: Step the page text size (medium → large → medium → small)
entries.gesture_en: Change the text size in Settings

target.zh: 回复卡上的 Agent 名字
target.en: The Agent's name on the reply card

entries.zh: 给 Agent 改名
entries.en: Rename the Agent

target.zh: 另一台遥控器发的原话卡上的来源名
target.en: The source label of a message sent from another remote

entries.zh: 给发这条消息的另一台遥控器改名
entries.en: Rename the other remote that sent this message
entries.gesture_zh: 长按页眉左边的来源名
entries.gesture_en: Hold the source label at the left of the header

entries.zh: 看后台在干活的 Agent 清单
entries.en: See which agents are at work in the background

entries.zh: 请 Agent 重新画机器人（换主题）
entries.en: Ask the Agent to redraw the robots (theme)

entries.zh: 看Agent J 主机现在有多忙（系统负载）
entries.en: See how busy the computer is (system load)
entries.gesture_zh: 点 Agent 名字下面的负载线
entries.gesture_en: Tap the load line under the Agent's name

entries.zh: 看额度用了多少
entries.en: See how much quota is used
entries.gesture_zh: 点顶部或输入框上方的灰线
entries.gesture_en: Tap the grey line at the top or above the message box

target.zh: 顶部「模型 · 思考强度」左半边
target.en: Left half of the model · effort label

entries.zh: 换下一个模型（只改显示，停手 5 秒才生效）
entries.en: Switch to the next model (shown at once, applied after 5 s without another tap)

target.zh: 顶部「模型 · 思考强度」右半边
target.en: Right half of the model · effort label

entries.zh: 换下一档思考强度（只改显示，停手 5 秒才生效）
entries.en: Switch to the next effort level (shown at once, applied after 5 s without another tap)

target.zh: 顶部「模型 · 思考强度」

entries.zh: 模型和思考强度都回到默认（立即生效）
entries.en: Back to the default model and effort (at once)
entries.gesture_en: Hold the model or the effort
entries.allowReserved: Existing owner-required M; ChromeOS reserves it for Files. Use the model menu there.

target.zh: 右上角扫码图标；拍照按钮
target.en: Scan icon at the top right; the camera button

entries.zh: 扫二维码（新设备的配对码、好友名片，或者任何二维码）
entries.en: Scan a QR code (a new device's pairing code, a friend's card, or anything else)
entries.gesture_zh: 点扫码图标；长按拍照按钮
entries.gesture_en: Tap the scan icon; hold the camera button

target.en: The gear at the top right

entries.zh: 打开设置
entries.en: Open Settings

target.en: The magnifier at the top right

entries.zh: 搜索当前这一页：聊天里搜聊天记录，工作流 / 技能 / 记忆 / Agent J 页筛卡片，设置、菜单页和打开的文档在页内查找（输入框里的 Ctrl+K 仍是删到行尾），再按一次清空并关闭
entries.en: Search the page you are on: the chat history in the chat, the cards on Workflows / Skills / Memory / Agent J, the text of Settings, a menu page or an open document (inside the message box Ctrl+K still deletes to the end); press again to clear and close

keywords.zh: 查找 搜索 聊天记录

entries.zh: 显示这张快捷键表
entries.en: Show this list of shortcuts

target.en: The Pending tag at the top

entries.zh: 重新打开收起的审批卡或问题卡
entries.en: Reopen the approval or question card you put away

target.en: Unpaired page: scan the QR code

entries.zh: 在未配对页扫Agent J 主机终端或账户页上的配对二维码
entries.en: On the unpaired page, scan the pairing QR code from the terminal or the account page
entries.nokey: 未配对页没有键盘快捷键（按钮可用 Tab 选中）

target.zh: 未配对页命令旁的复制图标
target.en: Unpaired page: copy icon next to a command

entries.zh: 复制旁边那条命令（agentj pair 等）
entries.en: Copy the command next to it (agentj pair …)
entries.nokey: 未配对页没有键盘快捷键（按钮可用 Tab 选中）

entries.zh: 进入输入框；在输入框里按 Esc 离开（输入的字保留）
entries.en: Into the message box; Esc in it leaves (the draft stays)

target.zh: 输入框左边的 ≡「全部命令」
target.en: ≡ All commands, left of the message box

entries.zh: 命令菜单：在输入框外按 / 直接进输入框，斜杠已经填好，命令菜单随即弹出；弹窗或设置开着时不抢
entries.en: Commands: / outside the message box jumps in with / typed and the command menu open; not while a dialog or Settings is open
entries.allowReserved: Firefox quick find only when the page does not take /

entries.zh: 定制我的命令（请 Agent 增删改 / 菜单里的命令）
entries.en: Customise my commands (ask the Agent to add, change or remove / commands)

entries.zh: 选文件发给 Agent
entries.en: Pick a file for the Agent

entries.zh: 把剪贴板里的文字放进输入框
entries.en: Put the clipboard text into the message box

entries.zh: 从相册选图片
entries.en: Pick pictures from the photo library

entries.zh: 把剪贴板里的图片作为附件
entries.en: Attach the picture on the clipboard

entries.zh: 拍照
entries.en: Take a photo

entries.zh: 按住说话，松开直接发送（滑出取消）；键盘 m 松开仍转文字
entries.en: Hold to talk, release to send (slide out to cancel); keyboard m still releases to text

entries.zh: 锁定录音，松手继续录；任意键或再点一下结束，Esc 取消
entries.en: Lock the recording; any key or another tap ends it, Esc cancels

entries.zh: 发送（Shift+Enter 换行；内容长时用全屏编辑）
entries.en: Send (Shift+Enter for a new line; long text: the full-screen editor)

entries.zh: 调发送提示音的音量
entries.en: Set the send sound's volume
entries.gesture_en: Hold Send and slide up or down

entries.zh: 把文件或截图放进附件（拖到页面上，或者在输入框里粘贴）
entries.en: Attach files or screenshots (drop them on the page, or paste in the message box)

entries.zh: 输入框空着时翻之前发过的话
entries.en: With the message box empty: bring back what you sent before

entries.zh: 输入框空着或光标已在头 / 尾时，直接翻上一条 / 下一条
entries.en: With the box empty or the cursor already at that end: previous / next page

entries.zh: 和终端一样：到行首 / 行尾，删到行首 / 行尾，删前一个词，贴回刚删掉的，删光标后一个字（Ctrl+W 在普通浏览器标签页里可能直接关标签，装到桌面的网页版里可用）
entries.en: As in a terminal: line start / end, delete to start / end, delete the previous word, paste back what was deleted, delete the next character (Ctrl+W may close a normal browser tab; it works in the installed web app)
entries.allowReserved: terminal habits inside the message box only; documented caveat for Ctrl+W; Ctrl+D (bookmark) only while typing

target.zh: 输入框上方引用条最右边的 ✕
target.en: ✕ at the right end of the quotes above the message box

entries.zh: 取消引用（有两段以上时，一次清空全部）
entries.en: Cancel the quote (with two or more, clears them all)

entries.zh: 在输入框外按两下 Esc 清空文字和附件（✕ 只清文字，可以撤销）。Esc 从不打断 Agent；要停下当前任务，点 Stop 按钮或发 /stop
entries.en: Esc twice outside the message box clears text and attachments (✕ clears the text only, with undo). Esc never interrupts the Agent; to stop the current task, use the Stop button or send /stop

entries.zh: 锁定录音时结束录音，转成文字放进输入框
entries.en: End a locked recording; the text goes into the message box
entries.gesture_zh: 点录音卡上的结束图标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the end icon on the recording card
entries.nokey: 锁定录音时任意键就是结束（见 compose.talk_lock）

entries.zh: 取消锁定的录音，不转文字
entries.en: Cancel a locked recording; nothing is transcribed
entries.gesture_zh: 点录音卡上的取消图标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the cancel icon on the recording card
entries.nokey: Esc 取消锁定的录音（见 compose.talk_lock）

target.zh: 输入框上方的一段引用（两段以上时）
target.en: One quote above the message box (with two or more)

entries.zh: 点时间跳回原回复并高亮这一段；点文字看全文；点它右上角的 ✕ 只删这一段
entries.en: Tap the time to go back to its reply with the words highlighted; tap the words to read them in full; its own ✕ removes just that one
entries.gesture_zh: 点引用的时间 / 文字 / ✕
entries.nokey: Several small targets in one strip; Esc clears them all.

entries.zh: 锁定录音时一步结束并直接发送：短的转成文字发出，长的作为语音附件发出，不用再点发送
entries.en: End a locked recording and send it in one step: a short one goes as text, a long one as a voice attachment — no second tap on send
entries.gesture_zh: 点录音卡上的发送图标
entries.gesture_en: Tap the send icon on the recording card
entries.nokey: 锁定录音时任意键是结束（见 compose.talk_lock）；直接发送只在录音卡上点

target.zh: 输入框上方第 5 个按钮（全屏）
target.en: The fifth button above the message box (full screen)

entries.zh: 打开全屏编辑器（输入框里也能按；字原样带进去，内容超过一行时按钮角上显示有几行）
entries.en: Open the full-screen editor (also from inside the message box; the words come along, and past one line the button shows how many lines)
entries.gesture_zh: 点全屏按钮，或手指按住输入框往上滑
entries.gesture_en: Tap the full-screen button, or swipe up on the message box

entries.zh: 换行（和 Shift+Enter 一样；行末打一个 \ 再按 Enter 也是换行，和终端一样）
entries.en: New line (like Shift+Enter; a \ at the end of the line, then Enter, does the same — as in a terminal)
entries.allowReserved: Ctrl+J (downloads page) only while typing in the message box, as in a terminal

entries.zh: 暂存草稿：输入框里的字先放一边，再按一次取回（只在这个页面里）
entries.en: Put the draft aside; press again to bring it back (this page only)
entries.allowReserved: Ctrl+S (save page) only while typing in the message box, as Claude Code's stash

entries.zh: 在之前发过的话里找含有输入框这几个字的那条；再按继续往前找
entries.en: Find an earlier message that contains what the box says; again = further back
entries.allowReserved: Ctrl+R (reload) only while typing in the message box, as a terminal's history search

target.en: Top-left icon of the full-screen editor

entries.zh: 退出全屏，文字原样回到输入框
entries.en: Leave full screen; the words go back to the message box as they are
entries.gesture_zh: 点左上角图标，在空白处双击（在文字上双击仍是选字），或按住顶部中间的横杠往下拉（拉得不够会弹回去）
entries.gesture_en: Tap the top-left icon, double-tap blank space (on words a double tap still selects), or pull the bar at the top centre down (not far enough and it springs back)

target.en: Send at the bottom right of the full-screen editor

entries.zh: 发送（全屏里 Enter 只换行）
entries.en: Send (in full screen Enter is a new line)
entries.gesture_en: Tap Send at the bottom right

target.zh: 全屏编辑右上角清空图标
target.en: Top-right clear icon of the full-screen editor

entries.zh: 清空全部文字（5 秒内可以撤销）
entries.en: Clear all the words (undo within 5 seconds)
entries.nokey: a one-off tap with its own undo; Ctrl+U / Ctrl+K clear by line

target.zh: 全屏编辑左下角的斜杠图标
target.en: The slash icon at the bottom left of the full-screen editor

entries.zh: 命令列表：选一条插到光标处（可搜索，↑↓ 选，Enter 插入）
entries.en: Command list: the one you pick goes in at the caret (search, ↑↓ to choose, Enter to insert)
entries.gesture_en: Tap the slash icon at the bottom left
entries.nokey: a list to pick from; typing / in the message box opens the same list

entries.zh: 和输入框一样的终端编辑键：到行首 / 行尾，删到行首 / 行尾，删前一个词，贴回刚删的，删光标后一个字
entries.en: The same terminal keys as the message box: line start / end, delete to start / end, delete the previous word, paste back, delete the next character
entries.allowReserved: terminal habits inside the editor only; Ctrl+W may close a normal browser tab

entries.zh: 焦点在输入框外时，进入输入框并打开 @ 列表
entries.en: Outside the message box, focus it and open the @ list

entries.zh: 退出全屏阅读
entries.en: Leave the full-screen reader
entries.gesture_zh: 双击文字；点右下角的书本（回复也会退出）
entries.gesture_en: Double-tap the text; tap the book (bottom right; reply leaves too)

entries.zh: 调大 / 调小全屏阅读的字号
entries.en: Larger / smaller text in the reader
entries.gesture_zh: 两指捏合；点左下角的字号图标，拖滑块或点 + / −
entries.gesture_en: Pinch; tap the text-size icon (bottom left), then drag the slider or tap + / −

entries.zh: 往上 / 往下滚一段；空格翻一屏
entries.en: Scroll up / down; Space for a screen

entries.zh: 同一条回复里的上一个 / 下一个文件
entries.en: Previous / next file of the same reply

entries.zh: 下载正在预览的文件
entries.en: Download the file being previewed

entries.zh: 关闭预览
entries.en: Close the preview

entries.zh: 选结果，Enter 打开那一条
entries.en: Pick a result; Enter opens it

entries.zh: 换到之前 / 之后的一次搜索
entries.en: Earlier / later searches

entries.zh: 关闭搜索
entries.en: Close the search

entries.zh: 批准，等于长按批准走完（验证本人照常）；审批卡开着时优先给它，输入框里的发送让位
entries.en: Approve, the same as holding the approve button (identity checks as usual); the card wins over the message box

target.en: Top right of the approval card

entries.zh: 收起审批卡，不算批准也不算拒绝；点顶部「待处理」再打开
entries.en: Put the card away, neither approved nor denied; tap Pending at the top to reopen it

entries.zh: 打开五页菜单
entries.en: Open the five-page menu

entries.zh: 升级主机（手机确认）
entries.en: Upgrade computer (confirm on phone)
entries.gesture_zh: 点击设置里的升级主机

entries.zh: 更新并刷新网页
entries.en: Update and reload page
entries.gesture_zh: 点击设置里的更新并刷新
entries.gesture_en: Tap Update and reload in Settings

target.zh: ≡ 全部命令：重新加载配置

entries.allowReserved: P320 (Leo 10-15): Reload needs a key and every free Alt+Shift letter is a ChromeOS shell key; L = reLoad. The ≡ row and /reload work everywhere

entries.zh: 直接打开一张卡片：Alt+Shift+卡片英文名里的一个字母（先取首字母，已被别的键占用就取下一个，字母都占了用数字 1–9、0），输入框里也能按；再按一次或 Esc 回到对话。每张卡片现在的键位列在本页最上面的卡片一节，卡片标题上带下划线的字母就是它的键，新加的卡片自动分到一个
entries.en: Open a card directly: Alt+Shift + a letter of the card's English name (the first letter; if another key has it, the next one; when all are taken, a digit 1–9, 0), also while typing; again, or Esc, goes back to the chat. Each card's key right now is listed in the cards section at the top of this page, the underlined letter in a card's title is its key, and a new card gets one by itself
